app_fee.value: No application fee is stated on the MCQST, IMPRS-QST, or shared MQV doctoral fellowship application pages.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee or fee waiver policy is stated on the MCQST, IMPRS-QST, or shared MQV doctoral fellowship pages.

gre_general.value: The required upload list (CV, letter of interest and motivation, degree certificates and transcripts, optional award certificates, and two referees) does not mention the GRE.

toefl_min.value: The program language is English, and no TOEFL requirement or minimum score is stated for doctoral fellowship applicants.
toefl_min.quote: The language of the program is English.

ielts_min.value: The program language is English, and no IELTS requirement or minimum score is stated for doctoral fellowship applicants.
ielts_min.quote: The language of the program is English.

english_waiver.value: No formal English test requirement or English-medium exemption rule is stated on the MCQST/IMPRS-QST/MQV fellowship pages.

notes: IMPRS-QST Doctoral Fellowships are integrated into the unified MCQST Doctoral Program, which shares an online application portal (https://application.imprs-quantum.mpg.de/public/) with the Munich Quantum Valley (MQV) Doctoral Fellowship Program. Checked IMPRS-QST, MCQST application/overview/guidelines/join pages, the shared portal, and MQV doctoral fellowship page; no application fee, GRE, or TOEFL/IELTS rules are stated.
